intentSummary: Create the TPO compression breakout: a narrow prior-session value area is a coiled auction, and a close accepted outside it is the breakout. Two required, direction-neutral gates - the prior value area is in the bottom quartile of width, and the close has broken out of it - block compose-trade otherwise. UP when the close is accepted above the prior value high, DOWN when below, NEITHER while coiled or when value is wide. Prior-session columns only. Weights, gates, levels and trailing mirror the vendor's validated volatility-compression breakout playbook; no signal is required.
assumptions: Measured 2026-09-12 over 36 CRYPTO instruments: prior value-area width min 1.16, p25 2.32, median 3.00, p75 4.63, max 10.36 percent. NARROW is the bottom quartile, 2.3 percent. Yesterday's p25 was 2.06. The threshold moves day to day; it is one instant and will be re-derived from forward logging.

Measured 2026-09-12: at width <= 2.3, 9 of 36 are narrow and 6 of those are outside prior value (ETH LTC BNB above; WLFI LINK TRUMP below). So both gates pass on 6 of 36 at creation - rarer than the rotation book by design, breakouts are rarer than rotations.
Measured: spread(M,O) = (M - O)/O in percent, positive meaning M sits above O. So a close ABOVE the prior VAH reads pTpoVAH_close_spread < 0; the 0.05 percent edge is one 5-bps bin of acceptance.
Measured 2026-09-12 on 3d720de3 rev 3: a required, verdict-null condition blocks compose-trade for long and short alike. Both gates here use that pattern; direction comes from the verdict ladder.

Weights, gates (0.55 / 0 / 0.8), levels (0.75-1.75 ATR, RR 2) and trailing (BE 1R, trail 1.2R, giveback 35, buffer 0.3) MIRROR the vendor's CI-validated Playbook 1. That playbook is a 4h swing; this runs on the 1h anchor because the prior-session levels are timeless. Not invented, but the anchor differs and the fit is unmeasured.

Playbook 1 marks bollinger_squeeze and volume_surge required. Here every signal is required:false because the TPO gates already gate and this project measured signal families silent for whole days; a required signal on a silent day would block every trade rather than the flat ones.

Not claimed: that a close one bin outside prior value is acceptance rather than a probe. TPO has no history and OHLC no intrabar sequence; ON_CANDLE_CLOSE is the only confirmation the platform expresses.
Scope: CREATE only. No agent bound, nothing deployed, no funds allocated. Quota was 10 of 25.
